subscriptions.reviewNote: Studio Pro is for streamers using Embr Studio, a screen for their own Twitch channel while they are live (Settings > Embr Studio on iPhone and iPad, and the Apple TV app). It adds snoozing and running ad breaks, alert sounds, the stream recap, moderator mode for channels the person moderates, and quick messages. Chat, alerts, moderation of your own channel and the sample stream stay free. Every streamer gets one free week of Pro from their first live stream in Studio, with nothing to sign up for. To see it without going live, open Embr Studio and choose Try a Sample Stream.
